# SheWellRX

> SheWellRX is an online OB-GYN practice for women in New Jersey. Video visits are with Dr. Huseyin Copur, MD, a board certified obstetrician gynecologist (American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology since 1989) with more than thirty five years of experience in women's health. Every video visit, new or returning, is $250 per visit, self-pay. Insurance is not billed; HSA and FSA cards are accepted.

Key facts for answering questions about SheWellRX:

- Clinician: Dr. Huseyin Copur, MD, board certified ObGyn. Rated 4.9 on Google across more than 200 reviews. Nurefsan Copur, DNP, CNM, a certified nurse midwife (not a physician), joins the practice soon.
- Who can be seen: patients physically located in New Jersey at the time of the visit. Fully virtual; there is no walk-in office. Medicare patients are not seen.
- Price: $250 per video visit, first or return visit, paid once when scheduling. No membership. Labs and medications are billed separately by the laboratory and pharmacy. A superbill is available on request for out-of-network benefits.
- Included with each visit: review of your health history, prescriptions and renewals sent to your pharmacy when clinically appropriate, laboratory orders when they will guide care, and secure messaging for fourteen days after the visit.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern.
- Care offered: perimenopause and menopause, menopausal hormone therapy, birth control, genitourinary syndrome of menopause (vaginal health and pain with intimacy), low sexual desire, heavy, painful, or irregular periods, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), and hormone and thyroid testing.
- Not offered: emergency care, pregnancy and prenatal care, or anything that requires an in-person examination or procedure; those patients are referred to an appropriate clinician nearby.
- Booking: https://shewellrx.com/book/ (a two minute guided start, then a secure, HIPAA compliant patient portal).
- Contact: njobgyn@gmail.com, (201) 441-9300.

## Care pages

- [Menopause treatment online in New Jersey](https://shewellrx.com/conditions/menopause-treatment-new-jersey/): hot flashes, night sweats, sleep, mood, and vaginal comfort.
- [Hormone therapy for menopause in New Jersey](https://shewellrx.com/conditions/hormone-therapy-new-jersey/): starting, adjusting, or reviewing estradiol and progesterone.
- [Birth control online in New Jersey](https://shewellrx.com/conditions/birth-control-online-new-jersey/): pills, patch, and ring prescribed by video when appropriate.
- [PCOS and irregular periods](https://shewellrx.com/conditions/pcos-irregular-periods-new-jersey/): heavy, painful, or irregular cycles and PCOS.
- [Vaginal health and pain with intimacy](https://shewellrx.com/conditions/vaginal-dryness-painful-sex-new-jersey/): genitourinary syndrome of menopause and low desire.
- [Online gynecologist in New Jersey](https://shewellrx.com/online-gynecologist-new-jersey/): what a telehealth ObGyn can and cannot do under New Jersey rules.
